# Résumé général

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| include: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false


library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(sf)
library(kableExtra)


source(here::here("R","trip_functions.R"))

load(here("data","NewlyCreatedData","rawLocRouzic2023.Rdata"))

#summarize all trips and periods on land by individuals
raw_trips_rouzic23<-trips_summary_ind(raw_rouzic_2023,colony=colo_coord_rouzic)
raw_land_rouzic23<-land_summary_ind(raw_rouzic_2023,colony=colo_coord_rouzic)

summy.trips.ad<-raw_trips_rouzic23 %>% 
    dplyr::filter(stage=="adult") %>% 
    group_by(id) %>% 
    summarize(NbLocs=sum(nlocs),
              Nbtrajet=n(),
              DateMin=min(DateStart),
              DateMax=max(DateEnd),
              Sex=sex[1],
              stage=stage[1],
              sero=sero[1],
              Duréemoy=mean(TripDurh),
              Distmax=max(Distmaxkm))

kbl(summy.trips.ad,caption="Summary of raw trips for aduts") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))


summy.trips.juv<-raw_trips_rouzic23 %>% 
    dplyr::filter(stage=="juvenile") %>% 
    group_by(id) %>% 
    summarize(NbLocs=sum(nlocs),
              Nbtrajet=n(),
              DateMin=min(DateStart),
              DateMax=max(DateEnd),
              Sex=sex[1],
              stage=stage[1],
              sero=sero[1],
              Duréemoy=mean(TripDurh),
              Distmax=max(Distmaxkm))

kbl(summy.trips.juv,caption="Summary of raw trips for juveniles") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))

```
